newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel, tin, copper gain in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel, tin, copper gain in modest trade.

text.p: Nickel, tin and copper made gains in modest trade on Thursday while other base metals were steady, dealers said.
They said the rise in the prices of copper, nickel and tin was mainly in response to an uptrend on the London Metals Exchange (LME).
Copper rose 100 rupees to 13,600 rupees per quintal. Nickel was up 300 rupees at 36,400 rupees per quintal. Tin moved up by 200 rupees to 31,400 rupees per quintal.
Alunium was steady at 7,450 rupees per quintal. Zinc was unchanged at 7,900 rupees per quintal. Lead was offered at 4,500 rupees per quintal.
